provisional_regression_gate.policy: paired median candidate/baseline exceeds 1.03 and 95% bootstrap interval is entirely above 1.0; inspect every recorded timing, CPU and peak-memory metric and each kernel

limitations: Native ARM64 only; no fresh x86-64 or wasm32 execution. The optional optimizing backend was checked and its 10 creation tests passed, but acceptance timings use the ordinary default JIT.

React reducer, Vue reactivity and Djot are extracted application components; EJS is the actual examples/ejs/code.js solver. No full browser, Speedometer, scene frame-rate or general 8-10x speedup claim.

Six interleaved fresh-process pairs per main workload and twenty startup pairs; five internal samples per WebGL-shaped CPU kernel. Unrelated desktop applications stayed active; owned builds, tests and profilers finished before timing.

The exploratory profile uses the preceding candidate, before allocation-free rejected getter proof lookup. It left 3602 of 17491 samples unresolved versus zero of 17772 baseline samples; category changes and inclusive stacks are not exclusive causal attribution.

These changes begin the packed-runtime/shared-metadata/resolution work. Ordinary properties still keep separate 16-byte Property records; generic runtime and proxy/callback interfaces still use wide Value.
